    from collections import Counter, deque
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if seen[i][j] or g[i][j]==bg: continue
            c=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.popleft(); comp.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na,nb=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==c:
                        seen[na][nb]=True; q.append((na,nb))
            i0=min(x for x,y in comp); i1=max(x for x,y in comp)
            j0=min(y for x,y in comp); j1=max(y for x,y in comp)
            if i1>i0+1 and j1>j0+1 and len(comp)==2*(i1-i0+1)+2*(j1-j0-1):
                f=7 if ((i1-i0-1)*(j1-j0-1))%2 else 2
                for x in range(i0+1,i1):
                    for y in range(j0+1,j1):
                        out[x][y]=f
    return out
''')
